notes.title: Patch v1.01
notes.notes: Hello All, I hope you are all well, the first patch for Eletar Hero comes in the form of a bug fix for the rare situation of lagging of the game when you complete a level and lose all of your health at the same time. This patch also highlights when you have collected one of the 36 Glyphs of the Eletar's ancient language.

notes.title: March Discount!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41775065/97c7bf12a7cb08888064dd85832540f4f73894f9.png[/img]
Hello All, It's been just over a month since Eletar Hero was able to jump onto your systems, we thought it would be nice to do a little one-month celebration with a....discount!! So come jump into the world of Eletar Hero and help Aaron speed save the world from the Madman that is Mr Stevens!
